story.anc_5_sonnen.dlg.stag4_jane_timer_: Wait. The biosignatures of the members of <color=#FFFEC1>the Inner Rite</color> are gone. Just gone. The cameras show nothing either. It is as if they evaporated. I do not understand what is happening. Molay is alive. He is aboard his HIS, the same one he used to send the capsule with the Emitter. He demands that the boss come to him in person. You are cleared for evacuation.
story.anc_5_sonnen.dlg.stage1_ancom_defe: Fewer than four members of the Inner Rite survived. The ritual has been disrupted.
story.anc_5_sonnen.dlg.stage1_ancom_devi: We intercepted the signal. Mercenary, listen carefully. Evil deceives. If the ritual had been made to summon it, it would not need to send quasimorphs here. The final phase is beginning. From this moment on, <color=#FFFEC1>the Inner Rite</color> cannot be distracted from the ritual. They will not move, respond to threats, or defend themselves. If necessary, they will die without leaving the circle. At least four members of the Rite must survive for the ritual to be completed. Otherwise, there will be horror without end. Destroy every quasimorph that evil sends in its desperate attempt to avoid defeat.
story.anc_5_sonnen.dlg.stage1_ancom_gree: <color=#FFFEC1>The Inner Rite</color> has begun synchronizing minds for the ritual. Nothing is required of you yet. You do not have to stand still if you feel like stretching your legs. I cannot imagine what a clone’s metabolism feels like burning from the inside, but I have read a great deal about it. Look around if you want. Walk through the hall. Check your weapon. Just stay near us and do not leave the section. The ritual must become stable. From this moment on, the members of the Inner Rite will not be distracted by anything that happens around them, whatever it may be.
story.anc_5_sonnen.dlg.stage1_ancom_time: We are detecting <color=#FFFEC1>Shartmakhum</color> surging toward the station. This should not have happened—there is no violence on site, and no other channels for eccolapse. We chose not to keep the <color=#FFFEC1>Andreev Emitter</color> near the ritual. The risk of interference was too great. Now that risk is smaller than inaction. You need to reach the third floor. That is the station's Docking Level. We will send a capsule with the Emitter there. Retrieve the device, return to the Ritual Section, and connect it to the control computer. That should completely remove the pressure from the bramfatura of <color=#FFFEC1>Mercury</color>.
story.anc_5_sonnen.dlg.stage1_ancom_wave: The surge of Shartmakhum is withdrawing from the station. The ritual has entered its final phase and no longer requires your presence nearby. Go up the stairs to the fourth floor, to the staff recreation area, and wait there for the operation to conclude. Enjoy the Sun, clone. Do not interfere with the final part.
story.anc_5_sonnen.dlg.stage1_device_anc: We need to check the interference level... Good. The Emitter is not disrupting the ritual. Connect it to the control computer. The bramfatura's influence should withdraw completely, or... at least weaken.
story.anc_5_sonnen.dlg.stage1_gagtungr_d: The ritual is nearing completion. Nine minds are linked. A soulless creature has been placed in the breach. The device is sending impulses toward the place from which I am coming. The Sun illuminates the ritual site. Everything has converged into one. I am already touching reality. Complete the ritual, and I will manifest.
story.anc_5_sonnen.dlg.stage1_gagtungr_w: They say: step away. They say: wait for the end. The ritual is already complete. Nine minds were linked in a circle, and the soulless creature was near. It is you who must complete your role—the sacrifice. Kill them all, and everything will conclude according to plan.
story.anc_5_sonnen.dlg.stage2_jane_greet: It has started. Quasimorph signatures all over the level. AnCom said this was impossible. Apparently Shartmakhum did not receive the memo. Push through to the Docking Level — they have already launched the capsule toward the station.
story.anc_5_sonnen.dlg.stage3_jane_greet: This is the Docking Level. The capsule with the <color=#FFFEC1>Andreev Emitter</color> will arrive through one of the available airlocks. Once the capsule arrives, take the Emitter and return to the Ritual Section. And one more thing—the quasimorphs of Shartmakhum are, of course, waiting for you here as well.
story.anc_5_sonnen.dlg.stage4_jane_greet: Here is the recreation area. Very funny, but what can we do? Rest, then. Wait. Molay says it will all be over soon.
story.anc_5_sonnen.name: Sonnenmensch
story.anc_5_sonnen.objective0: Wait until the ritual ends. At least four members of the Inner Rite must survive.
story.anc_5_sonnen.stage1.name: Ritual Section
story.anc_5_sonnen.stage2.name: Agricultural Level
story.anc_5_sonnen.stage3.name: Docking Level
story.anc_5_sonnen.stage4.name: Recreation Area
story.awake_olirna.dlg.event1: Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth? Are not his days also like the days of an hireling? As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow, and as an hireling looketh for the reward of his work: so am I made to possess months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.
story.awake_olirna.dlg.event2: "Revenge is a dish best served cold," is it not? When you are done playing with the lives of clones for the profit of others, think about returning to the Red Land and taking your revenge after all. It will be sweet, believe me.
story.awake_olirna.dlg.event3_ancom: The ancient order... They gather minds the way a shepherd gathers the flock before a storm. But the flock does not know it is led not into shelter, but prepared for slaughter. For behind such unity there is always the name of one who hungers.
story.awake_olirna.dlg.event3_civres: Some great philosophers of the past taught that the many suffer from a thirst for unity. Others taught that the one is the final sickness of the many. Let the dead argue over that. The uprising is already split. It has two beginnings. One seeks to become a voice without faces; the other, a face for an alien flame.
story.awake_olirna.dlg.event3_realware: Hardware is mistakenly taken for an instrument of victory. A field is not cleared so that peace may reign upon it, but so that a new battle may take place there. The cleaner the horizon once the dust has settled, the nearer comes the one who will claim the right to call war itself salvation.
story.awake_olirna.dlg.event3_tezctlan: A ruler who raises a temple to his own name rarely knows whom exactly he is crowning. Priests do not care whom they anoint to rule. They consecrate the throne itself, not the particular sovereign. When the cup overflows, the drinker and the drink will bear one name.
story.awake_olirna.dlg.event3_xiomara: The Spider Queen spins her webs. As it should be. Amusingly, when the blade is raised against the king, it is not only the exile who rejoices, but her child as well. Not all who wage war upon the throne come to claim it.
story.awake_olirna.dlg.event4_ancom: The ancient order... They prepared a ritual to ensure that Gagtungr would never appear. Yet on Saturn, an icy flame has already been lit, giving visible form to the greatness to come. You are almost too late, humans.
story.awake_olirna.dlg.event4_civres_god: They said that peace was born from strife. That is a consolation for the blind. When one uprising splits into reason and fire, a third witness awakens—a cold reservoir beyond the final circle. Saturn has awakened, and now both branches of the heretics draw sustenance from the same source.
story.awake_olirna.dlg.event4_hive: A hive mound is a fine way to coexist. But sometimes a refuge is built only so that it may be brought to heel. Saturn is awakening on the farthest reaches, and now the choir of the ancient order hears cold music from the edge of the System.
story.awake_olirna.dlg.event4_realware_s: The light of a thousand suns is not kindled simply to make things brighter. Venus is engulfed in flame, from without and from within. And to that radiance the distant storehouse of eternal cold— Saturn —has answered. Now the ruler to come has not only a personal executioner, but also the power needed for awakening.
story.awake_olirna.dlg.event4_tezctlan: The wise distinguish the crown from the head upon which it rests. The Emperor declared himself emerald, but the cosmos bestowed upon him a ring of ice. Saturn's cup has finally been opened. Now the empire of Tezctlan drinks not only the blood of its subjects, but also feeds upon the hoarded cold.
story.awake_olirna.dlg.event4_xiomara: You on Venus still think you are toppling a tyrant's throne, but in truth, you are only trying to crack the shell. Saturn's cup is already full, and so much cold has gathered in its dark waters that no sun will endure it.
story.awake_olirna.dlg.event5: I warn you that you are dealing with more than just a sleeping bramfatura. I managed to penetrate Olirna long ago. And this is not just another pandemonium—it seems to be a repository of energy that has been accumulating here for hundreds of millions of years. The situation is critical. Something terrible awaits the Solar System.
story.awake_xiomara.dlg.pact_activated:
Finally! You have kept your end of the bargain. From now on, we are bound by an unbreakable pact. Together, we will destroy Tezctlan. Once a freedom fighter, first among equals in the emerald crystal of Gannix, the king has gone mad. He must be stopped. He dreams of the Emerald Empire, wishing to expand it beyond Gannix. But he himself once fought against an insane tyrant possessed by the same delusions.

I will stay in your realm, on Venus. I will gather the Taltnoms loyal to liberty and fight Tezctlan here. You must head to Mars. There's a place there that you call Sinkhole Oasis. Long before any human ancestor looked up to the stars in fear, a battle took place there, which Tezctlan himself took part in. He emerged victorious, but there he lost his Spear. Itzpapalotl, the symbol of the ruler's fate in the Emerald Kingdom, was forever lost on Mars.

If you acquire this spear, you will be able to defeat the madman. For your realm, it is salvation from the monster. For Gannix, it is the path to freedom.
story.awake_xiomara.dlg.pact_activated2:
Fool! I am Tezctlan, Emperor of Eternal Gannix, lord of the boundless Emerald Empire! I am the leader of legions flying the banners of the Eagle, the Jaguar, the Python, and the Caiman! I am the one who will take Gagtungr's place. I am the one who is truly worthy to rule the Solar System.

Bow your head, mortal. Submit. In a realm devoid of the golden light of the Sun, the green radiance of Gannix will bring life and death.
story.awake_xiomara.dlg.xiomara_orbit_1:
I remember you. I've been waiting, hoping that you would show up again. And here you are. You've come close enough to Gannix for my call to reach your mind. But this proximity is not enough for us to make a pact. Do not fear, it will be beneficial for both of us.

Do you know why quasimorphosis occurs in the solid realm? Why do the barons come to you? To meet me, go to Venus. And just do your job. Massacre them the way you always do. Murders, cannibalism, limbs torn off. I will hear people screaming in agony. I will sense the sweet aroma of gavvakh, and I will know it's you. I will come to you in person Then we will discuss the terms of our alliance.
story.awake_xiomara.dlg.xiomara_orbit_2: I granted you the <color=#FFFEC1>Skull of the Feathered Serpent</color> so that you could make a pact with me. It’s waiting for you on your ship.
story.awake_xiomara.dlg.xiomara_venus_gi:
Oh yeah, I'm coming. The cries of the dying, pain leaving your bodies... It is a sweet-voiced choir of ecstasy. Gavvakh flows out of your bodies with the blood, torment, and life itself. Gavvakh streams through your realm and seeps into ours. We can drink it. Taltnoms crave gavvakh.

Satiated with it, we can tear through the invisible fabric separating our realm from yours. We whisper to you. We tempt you. We change you. And finally, when you have been turned into our servants and gavvakh is flowing, we can reveal ourselves. We do not lose our immortality. Our death in Kenom is merely an exile back to Gannix.

So when you killed me on Mercury, I did not die. Accept my gift, and we will make a pact. You will become my servant. I will give you the power to resist Tezctlan and protect the solid realm Your realm. Now finish the job you came here for. I will help you.
story.civ_1_manifesto.after: Well, the System will be in <color=#FFFEC1>chaos</color> for a while. Maybe it's for the best. Hard to believe in the good intentions of the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color>, but here's the good news: we won't have any less work. Get some rest, we'll be back in business soon.
story.civ_1_manifesto.briefing: <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color> didn't lie. The <color=#FFFEC1>transponders</color> installed on the shuttle worked. The station took us for one of their own. <color=#FFFEC1>Heritage</color> operates in semi-automatic mode. Easy job! Find our contact in the docks, take the virus from him, and upload it to the server on the <color=#FFFEC1>lower</color> floor of the station.
story.civ_1_manifesto.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Meet with the agent, retrieve the <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chip</color> and plug it in the station's mainframe.
story.civ_1_manifesto.details:
Details: The Civil Resistance, represented by Issachar, proposes that we carry out information sabotage on the scale of the Solar System. We need to connect the Red Chip and infect the global communications system with a generative virus that will destroy it.

Additional Info: Issachar, the CR coordinator in the Inner System, told us about the Red Chip—a device with which the rebels are going to disable communication channels throughout the Solar System. All we need is a powerful server to which most of the Network nodes are connected. Such a server exists and is located in orbit around Earth. Agent Justas will be waiting for us at the site to hand over the Red Chip.

Near-Earth orbit is a demilitarized zone. Corporations do not wage war there by agreement. The CR and pirates refrain from it because as they fear brutal vengeance. An attack on Heritage Communications Station could upset the fragile balance in the System. Our actions will kindle a flame that will be difficult to extinguish. We will help the cause of liberation of the working people, and there will be more work for us.

We need to take the Red Chip from the agent at the station, then seize the main communications computer and upload the received virus to it.
story.civ_1_manifesto.dlg.agent_contact_:
Greetings, comrade. You have been active throughout the Solar System lately. You’re clearly not against laboring for the benefit of the working man. So, let's cooperate! My name is Issachar. I am the commander of the Civil Resistance in the Inner System. And I’m offering you a job.

My colnodes have infiltrated the most unexpected assets of the Inner System. Including the orbit of Earth. I've managed to obtain data to fake an SBN transponder. It will allow you to get close to Heritage Station, reach the level where the server is located and connect a device to it.

Our agent Justas will be waiting for you at the station. Take the Red Chip from him. This is a special generative virus, the task of which is to transmit a counter-revolutionary message to all people of the System, and then... to deprive the corporate oppressors of the means of communication. Let's shut the mouths of the enemies of the working class!
story.civ_1_manifesto.dlg.cres_contact_a:
The immune response of the SBN Network was stronger than we expected. However, our virus has evolved. People all over the Solar System will now receive our summons. It will take the SBN years to catch it.

And one more thing, comrade. Earth no longer seems like an invulnerable sacred cow to anyone. The fires of a new war are about to flare in its orbit. Thank you.
story.civ_1_manifesto.dlg.cres_contact_c: The mainframe turned out to be better secured than I expected. You will have to <color=#FFFEC1>protect it</color> until the virus breaks through the defenses.
story.civ_1_manifesto.dlg.cres_contact_e:
Comrades! It is time to stand up to our oppressors! The corporations will feel the wrath of the working people! We, the workers, are the only ones who sweat and bleed for the good of humanity. The only ones who can turn matter into something. We are the Templars of the proletariat! We give ourselves to the great purpose. To transform the world from a state of chaos into a place for people to live! Without us, there would be no peace for those who oppress us to enjoy!

We fought during the Great Anarchist Revolution on both sides of the barricades. We trudged through the black mud of the Earth, our flesh was torn from our bones by the dust storms of Mars. And all this not for awards or glory. Only for the just cause that each of us believes in. When the states fell, what did the new order give us? Instead of the promised liberation, we were faced with new slavery.

But no one managed to break us! Listen to our message! Kill the nearest manager, seize a shuttle and go to the nearest Civil Resistance station! Do everything in your power. Let the Solar System be engulfed in the sacred fire of counterrevolution!
story.civ_1_manifesto.dlg.jane_chip_take: The <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chip</color> has to be plugged into the <color=#FFFEC1>mainframe</color>. I hope the Civil Resistance programmers did their job well. The elevator is unlocked, get going.
story.civ_1_manifesto.dlg.jane_chip_used: What the hell! The elevator is blocked again. You won't get out of here until the virus has dealt with the computer.
story.civ_1_manifesto.dlg.jane_computer_: The SBN has doubled the reward. Of course, our colleagues who were still on the sidelines will not miss such a chance. In addition to them, an <color=#FFFEC1>SBN Security Service</color> operational group is heading your way. Pull yourself together, it's going to get rough.
story.civ_1_manifesto.dlg.jane_control_r: The mainframe is very close. I'm afraid you'll have to fight your way through crowds of SBN operators to get out.
story.civ_1_manifesto.dlg.jane_elevator_: The alarm is blocking the elevator. We need to <color=#FFFEC1>find Justas</color>, he should have enhanced access.
story.civ_1_manifesto.dlg.jane_event_end: What pretentious nonsense... But I suppose it's a success. All station systems are unlocked, and we can <color=#FFFEC1>evacuate</color> you according to standard protocol.
story.civ_1_manifesto.dlg.jane_first_eli: One of the squads has been successfully eliminated, but don't relax. I'm picking up another group on our sensors.
story.civ_1_manifesto.dlg.jane_mainframe: You need the <color=#FFFEC1>Chip with the virus</color>, don't waste time!
story.civ_1_manifesto.dlg.jane_on_arrive: We've been spotted. Now all the PMC spacecrafts in the area have received the promise of a huge reward for your elimination. And many have responded. The mission is starting to look like our usual work. Find <color=#FFFEC1>Justas</color>, take the <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chip</color>, and make your way to the server.
story.civ_1_manifesto.dlg.jane_second_el: Oh, that's good. Should be a little easier now. The SBN will probably concentrate their best units in the <color=#FFFEC1>server room</color>.
story.civ_1_manifesto.dlg.jane_ustas_fou: It seems that <color=#FFFEC1>Justas</color> has been exposed, which is what caused the alarm. This does not affect our mission. Take <color=#FFFEC1>the Chip</color> to unlock the elevator.
story.civ_1_manifesto.dlg.stage3_jane_se: The SBN server has been destroyed, making it impossible to carry out Issaсhar’s plan for now. However, we still have a chance to evacuate the operative and return with reinforcements.
story.civ_1_manifesto.name: Manifesto
story.civ_1_manifesto.objective0: Find <color=#FFFEC1>Justas</color>, take the <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chip</color>, and plug it in the mainframe.
story.civ_1_manifesto.objective1: The virus is in the network. Evacuation is authorized.
story.civ_1_manifesto.stage1.name: Docks
story.civ_1_manifesto.stage2.name: Security Floor
story.civ_1_manifesto.stage3.name: Server Bay
story.civ_2_spark_flame.after: I must admit that your ability to sow chaos deserves respect. Thanks to your efforts, we have lost a unique, priceless asset. You don't understand, but the entire System has lost. The <color=#FFFEC1>General Crisis</color> is gaining momentum. However, by admitting defeat, we make it part of our plan. <color=#FFFEC1>Business</color> has suffered, but the <color=#FFFEC1>rules</color> of business remain the same. We'll meet again.
story.civ_2_spark_flame.briefing: We'll dock you to the <color=#FFFEC1>emergency airlock</color>. We can't provide you with a shuttle or a capsule, so you'll have to rely on your own strength. Behind the emergency airlock will be, surprisingly, the Emergency Floor. It's lightly guarded. You need to find a <color=#FFFEC1>terminal</color>, which should be somewhere nearby. Plug the <color=#FFFEC1>Red chip</color> into it, and it will do all the work. At least, that's what <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color> promises. Let's hope his plan works.
story.civ_2_spark_flame.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Using the <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chip</color>, infect the AI​ ​of the Unveiled, suppress resistance, and capture the spacecraft.
story.civ_2_spark_flame.details:
Details: Issachar wants to get his hands on HIS Unveiled. We have to plug the Red Chip into any terminal on the spacecraft and suppress any resistance from the crew.

Additional Info: We cannot use our shuttle for this mission. The only way to infiltrate the HIS is to dock an operator in a single-person capsule directly to the spacecraft's emergency airlock.
story.civ_2_spark_flame.dlg.ancom_chip_p: I had no doubt! It's you again. By the way, your virus has been eliminated. <color=#FFFEC1>SBN</color> kindly shared information about the <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chip</color> and the potential threats associated with it. You have nowhere to retreat and you are surrounded. Surrender and we guarantee you a quick death. Over and out.
story.civ_2_spark_flame.dlg.issahar_spac: The <color=#FFFEC1>revolution</color> has started and can no longer be stopped, comrade. This is not a question of justice, price, or number of victims. Any power is an apparatus of suppression in the hands of the <color=#FFFEC1>ruling class</color>. But Man has the right to choose which class will control this apparatus. The oppressors or the victims. The time has come to strike a <color=#FFFEC1>crushing blow</color> to the very heart of the system that has entangled us in <color=#FFFEC1>chains</color>. The <color=#FFFEC1>Unveiled</color> in the orbit of Venus, one of the three most advanced HIS, must become <color=#FFFEC1>ours</color>.
